scope: Bounded primary-source audit, three nearest methods: Aroma (OOPSLA2019), MAPO (ECOOP2009), PAM (FSE2016). GrouMiner was an initial search term only; not added as a fourth reviewed method.
question: Can local structure or API-use patterns retrieve candidates missed by large-token-overlap search? Retrieval is not refactoring benefit.
allowed: Official/authors' PDFs, official small source files/README/data metadata; no dependency install, builds or heavy runs
outputs: One requested note; encoded original PDFs and source files with URLs, hashes, failures in this run; no catalog/progress edits
pdf_storage: Primary-source downloads are raw acquisition; authored files use apply_patch. Failed encoded-output attempt retained in download ledger; no partial PDF accepted as original.
skill: research skill read. No spawn/delegate tool available after tool inventory; direct primary-source audit used, no claimed background agent.
